description: Check institutional memory for relevant scars before taking action. Returns matching scars and their lessons. Integrates variant assignment when issue_id provided.

issue_id.description: Linear issue identifier for variant assignment (e.g., 'PROJ-123'). When provided, scars with variants will be randomly assigned and formatted accordingly.

plan.description: What you're about to do (e.g., 'implement auth layer', 'deploy to production')

project.description: Project namespace (e.g., 'my-project'). Scopes sessions and searches.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) to include results. Weak matches below threshold are suppressed. Default: 0.4 (free tier BM25), 0.35 (pro tier embeddings).

name: recall
